description: This PHP source file defines a class 'Zend_Http_UserAgent_Features_Adapter_TeraWurfl' that implements the 'Zend_Http_UserAgent_Features_Adapter' interface. It is responsible for integrating the Tera Wurfl API to retrieve device capabilities based on HTTP request data. The class includes methods for loading the TeraWurfl library, handling configuration, and extracting device features.

classes.name: Zend_Http_UserAgent_Features_Adapter_TeraWurfl
classes.description: A class that implements device feature detection using the Tera Wurfl API within the Zend Framework, providing a method to extract features from HTTP requests.

methods.name: getFromRequest
methods.description: Static method to get device features from an HTTP request, loading the TeraWurfl class if necessary and handling configuration errors.

methods.name: getAllCapabilities
methods.description: Static method to extract and compile all device capabilities from a TeraWurfl object into an array.
